categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, design, production, and sales of high-precision, high-density, complex-shaped, and aesthetically refined precision components. Its primary business segments include Metal Injection Molding (MIM) precision components, other metal process products and plastic products, and molds and tooling. The products serve mainly the consumer electronics sector, including foldable screen hinges, power support parts for tablets and laptops, camera brackets, and components for smart wearables and drones.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced MIM technology, CNC machining, laser processing, wire cutting, stamping, and precision injection molding. It has proprietary capabilities in feedstock development, precision mold design and manufacturing, customized product development, production process optimization, and automation equipment development. The firm emphasizes innovation in new materials, complex structures, high precision, and automation to enhance product quality and manufacturing efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international consumer electronics brands and their EMS manufacturers, such as Apple, Honor, Amazon, and Anker Innovations. The end markets primarily cover foldable smartphones, tablets, laptops, desktops, smart capacitive pens, smart wearables, drones, and sports cameras. The company focuses on serving innovative brands with high technical and responsiveness requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Guangdong, Hunan (Changsha), and other regions. It also pursues an 'going out' strategy by establishing overseas production capacity to support expanding international markets. Its subsidiaries and investments span Hong Kong, the United States, and other locations, reflecting a global operational footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on precision component manufacturing and providing integrated precision component solutions. It engages in upstream R&D and materials development and downstream collaboration with EMS providers and brand owners, positioning itself as a key manufacturing partner in the consumer electronics supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening process innovation capabilities, expanding scalable precision manufacturing, enhancing risk resistance, and talent development. R&D focuses on new materials (e.g., titanium alloys, high-strength steels), advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and integration of MIM with 3D printing technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D (14.71% of revenue) to maintain technological leadership and support emerging sectors like AI, foldable screens, and extended reality devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized precision components to EMS providers designated by brand customers. The company participates early in product design and development phases, collaborating closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions, then realizes revenue through volume production and delivery of high-quality components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the MIM precision components industry in China, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with other precision component manufacturers in the consumer electronics sector, leveraging its strong process innovation, diversified manufacturing capabilities, and premium customer base to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 561.7 million, a 10.43% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 58.77 million, down 38.07% due to increased R&D investment and other factors. Total assets reached RMB 2.02 billion, up 19.76%, with a stable gross margin near historical averages. The company continues to expand production capacity and R&D personnel, indicating a growth trajectory focused on innovation and scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong process innovation, comprehensive precision manufacturing capabilities, rapid customer responsiveness, and high automation levels. It offers customized, high-precision, complex-structure components with reliable quality and delivery, supporting customers' innovative product development. Its integration of MIM with emerging technologies like 3D printing and AI-driven product trends further differentiates its offerings in the competitive consumer electronics market.
